_header: Diego Venegas-Vargas | DAMIC-M collaboration | CCDarkSens Framework -- Example input: WIMP-nucleon spin-independent rate generation with the DAMIC 2016 halo parameters (v0 = 220, vE = 232, vesc = 544 km/s, rho = 0.3 GeV/cm^3).
_comment: WIMP-nucleon SI rate generation, DAMIC 0.6 kg-day (PhysRevD.94.082006 / arXiv:1607.07410) halo-parameter reproduction. Standard halo parameters as quoted in the paper Sec. VIII (v0=220, vE=232, vesc=544 km/s, rho=0.3 GeV/cm^3), NOT the Baxter et al. 2021 defaults used elsewhere in this repo. Used by docs/ClusterFitMC_Design.md Phase 7 (Fig. 11 reproduction). Run: python3 utils/wimp_nucleon_generate_grid.py configs/wimp_nucleon_generate_si_damic2016halo.json UPDATED: quenching.model=chavarria_izraelevitch_table (adds Izraelevitch et al. 2017, arXiv:1702.00873, real measured data 2.28-20.67 keV_nr, closing the gap where the chavarria_table-only model fell back to unconstrained Lindhard theory -- see python/ccdarkphys/wimp_nucleon/quenching.py docstring). New rates_dir keeps the original chavarria_table-only CSVs intact for comparison.

quenching._comment: chavarria_table = measured Si nuclear recoil ionization efficiency, Chavarria et al. 2016 (Phys. Rev. D 94, 082007), Table I, with linear-to-zero below 0.68 keV_nr (crossing at 0.3 keV_nr per PhysRevD.94.082006) and Lindhard fallback above 2.28 keV_nr (no measurement there). See python/ccdarkphys/wimp_nucleon/quenching.py. Alternative: 'lindhard'.
